key_insight: Neural Certificate Pricing learns certificate-level dual prices to recover feasible combinatorial solutions efficiently, turning exponential search into amortized structured inference.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to build faster, more scalable solvers for combinatorial optimization problems where feasibility checks are easy but optimal certificates are expensive to search.
method: Train a neural network to predict certificate-level dual prices from problem instances.
Use a structured recovery layer to convert predicted prices into induced primal marginals.
Leverage certificate-consistency so recovered marginals remain globally feasible, with small price errors causing only second-order objective loss.
evidence_signal: Across three classes of combinatorial optimization problems, the method either outperforms strong neural baselines by large margins or matches them while using much less computation, and it generalizes better out of distribution.
watch_item: Performance depends on the certificate-consistency condition and the quality of the recovery layer, so unstable price predictions or mismatched problem structure could weaken feasibility guarantees.
paper_title: Neural Certificate Pricing for Combinatorial Optimization Problems
